title: The PI Property in Algebras of Polynomial Type
summary: In this article, we study the PI property for several families of noncommutative algebras of polynomial type. Specifically, we review criteria for the PI property in double Ore extensions, two-parameter quantum Heisenberg algebras, two-parameter quantum matrix algebras, the algebra $U_q^+(B_2)$, multiparametric quantum Weyl algebras, biquadratic algebras with three generators, Noetherian Down--Up algebras, and the recently introduced algebras $B_q(f)$.
